title: internal spawner
description:
Spawners that spawn items inside themselves
they can also be upgraded and mined with a Silk Touch pickaxe
body:
Tired of hostile mobs spawning and ruining your builds? This mod completely reimagines the vanilla spawner. Instead of endlessly generating mobs, spawners now produce items directly from the block itself.

Forget about experience farms and noisy monster grinders. Turn these dungeon structures into clean, efficient, and customizable sources of resources.

What does this mod do?
This mod alters the fundamental logic of the spawner. When activated by a nearby player, it spawns a set of items instead of an entity. It's the perfect solution for creating compact, safe farms inside your base or building decorative resource generation mechanics.

Key Features:
Safe & Silent Loot: No mob appears—meaning no damage, no noise, and no threat. Just pure, clean resources.

No XP Duplication: The mechanics are designed to prevent any experience points from dropping, keeping your game balanced and preventing exploits.

Fully Customizable Configuration:

Upon installation, the mod creates a dedicated folder in your config directory.

Inside, you'll find a YML database file where you can easily edit exactly which items each type of spawner produces.

You can also adjust drop chances and quantities to fit your gameplay.

Progression & Utility:

The mod supports increasing the spawner's level. A higher level can mean faster production or more valuable drops.

Spawners can be safely mined with a Silk Touch pickaxe, allowing you to collect them and relocate the perfect farming spot to your base.

Why download this mod?
Stop building complex mob-killing machines or dealing with unwanted spawns in your lit-up areas. Simply light up a spawner (to keep it safe and operational) and enjoy automatic item generation. The YML configuration database gives you fine-tuned control, making the mod suitable for everything from vanilla-style survival to hardcore modpacks with custom resources.

Requirements:
To ensure the mod functions correctly without issues like mob spawning or XP duplication, please make sure all required dependencies are installed (listed on the files page).
